## How they got there
Real Madrid secured their spot as the 2021-22 Champions League finalists by defeating Liverpool 1-0 in the final. Their journey was propelled by elite offensive metrics, specifically an average of 66.0 attacks per game, which placed them at the 97th percentile compared to all Champions League teams since 2011-12. This high tempo was complemented by exceptional discipline; they committed only 7.8 fouls per game, a figure that ranks in the 1st percentile across the same historical dataset, indicating superior control. Additionally, their pre-season UEFA club coefficient of 127.0 points (97th percentile among that season's teams) and a robust passing volume of 670 passes per game provided a strong foundation for their knockout run.

## Would the model have picked them?
The predictive model would likely have selected Real Madrid, as it assigned an 18.8% probability of reaching the final against a base rate of just 12.5%. This elevated probability placed them at rank 5 among all 16 teams that reached the knockout stages. The model's expected performance was calculated at 2.06 on its scale, suggesting a trajectory between the semi-finals and the final. While their low shot accuracy (55.3%) and infrequent long passes (8.8% of passes) acted as negative factors, the overwhelming positive contributions from their attacking frequency and defensive discipline pushed the model's expectation significantly upward.

## Weak spots
Despite their success, specific metrics dragged down the model's confidence. Real Madrid ranked in the 6th percentile for both season-specific and historical long pass usage (8.8%), a style that negatively impacted their expected stage by -0.1 rounds. Their shot accuracy of 55.3% was also a relative weakness compared to peers, resulting in a -0.07 contribution. Furthermore, they allowed opponents an average of 4.2 shots on target per game; while this is marked as "lower is better," their 39th percentile ranking suggests room for improvement in defensive containment compared to the league's elite.
